answer:
The job failed in the ocp4_workload_kestrel_ingress role, on the task "Render the ClusterIssuer manifest". The error says the undefined variable is kestrel_ingress_dns_zone, at templates/cluster-issuer.yaml.j2 line 15.

In that template, kestrel_ingress_dns_zone is read only inside the `{% if kestrel_ingress_acme_solver == 'route53-delegated' %}` branch, which builds a Route 53 DNS-01 solver. The role's defaults/main.yml sets kestrel_ingress_acme_solver to route53-delegated and gives kestrel_ingress_dns_zone no default, which is why the render failed.

So the deciding variable is kestrel_ingress_acme_solver, and the value that makes the template use kestrel_ingress_dns_zone is route53-delegated.

For a lab with no hosted zone, set kestrel_ingress_acme_solver to http01-router, the template's other branch. It builds an HTTP-01 solver through the router's ingress class and never reads kestrel_ingress_dns_zone, so no zone has to be supplied.
